detail.summary: Weekly durables wrap. Input inflation is the standout: the copper/aluminium/steel/plastic basket behind cooling appliances is up 41-45% yoy, yet appliance makers still expect double-digit festive growth despite price hikes. Second summer in West and South, rainfall 72% below LPA last week.

bullets.text: Avendus: ~47% of coverage trades >1sd below 5-year average valuation; ~80% of stocks fell last month, median -5.6%.

detail.summary: Quant screen across Avendus coverage: valuations have compressed broadly after a month-long sell-off, with far more names cheap versus their own history than rich. Highlights BUY-rated names that corrected most over three months.
points: Biggest 3M fallers with BUY: Thermax, Aptus, SP Apparels, Delhivery, Lupin
